entities.summary:
La maja desnuda, painted around 1800 by the renowned Spanish artist Francisco de Goya, represents a pivotal moment in the history of art, marking the transition towards modernity in European painting. This work, depicting a nude woman reclining in a sensuous pose, challenges the traditional representations of the female form prevalent in the art of the time, while reflecting the broader cultural shifts occurring in late 18th and early 19th century Europe. Goya, a court painter, used this canvas to confront societal norms and provoke discussions about morality and aesthetics in the context of the Enlightenment and the Age of Romanticism.

The painting, notable for its bold realism and psychological depth, is often interpreted as a commentary on the objectification of women and societal hypocrisy regarding sexuality. Commissioned by an unknown patron, the work was initially kept private, reflecting the controversial nature of its subject matter. Goya's technique, characterized by loose brushwork and vivid color, brought an emotional intensity to the piece, making it one of the early harbingers of modern art. La maja desnuda was eventually revealed to the public, leading to significant reactions that influenced both contemporaneous artists and later movements, including Impressionism and Modernism.
